title: Wispr Flow launches a Granola-styled meeting notetaker
summary: Wispr Flow is launching a meeting notetaker that generates summaries and action items, moving into productivity software similar to tools like Granola. The new feature signals the company's expansion beyond its core offering. This follows industry trends of AI-powered meeting productivity tools gaining market traction.
content: Wispr Flow's new terms of service indicate it will introduce a notetaker that generates meeting summaries and action items.

zh.title: Wispr Flow推出Granola风格的会议记录工具
zh.summary: Wispr Flow推出了一款会议记录工具,能生成摘要和行动项,进入了类似Granola的生产力软件领域。这一新功能标志着该公司业务范围的扩展。这是业界AI驱动的会议生产力工具获得市场关注的趋势的一部分。

title: Ted Lasso returns at an important time for Apple TV
summary: Apple TV is launching a fourth season of Ted Lasso as a soft reboot, mixing familiar characters with a substantially new cast. The return comes as Apple TV aggressively expands its content slate with new hits and returning favorites. The timing is significant as Apple TV pursues a larger share of the competitive streaming market.
content:
2026 is shaping up to be an excellent year for Apple TV. Apple's streaming service has built out an impressive slate that spans returning favorites like Silo and Sugar to all-new hits including OnlyFans-inspired dramedies, terrifying comedies, and paranoid tech thrillers. But the most important release might be a feel-good sports sitcom. After what seemed like a definitive finale, Ted Lasso is back with a fourth season that doubles as a soft reboot for the show, mixing up familiar characters with a substantially new cast. zh.title: 《Ted Lasso》在Apple TV的关键时期回归
zh.summary: Apple TV推出《Ted Lasso》第四季作为软重启,融合了熟悉的角色和全新阵容。该剧的回归正值Apple TV积极扩展内容库,推出新热门剧集和经典剧集回归之际。由于Apple TV争取在竞争激烈的流媒体市场占据更大份额,这个时机尤为重要。

title: SpaceX is coming for T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon
summary: SpaceX announced plans to build a terrestrial mobile network using spectrum purchased from EchoStar, directly competing with T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon. CEO Elon Musk and President Gwynne Shotwell revealed the strategy during SpaceX's first earnings call. The move signals SpaceX's intention to disrupt the wireless industry beyond its satellite internet business.
content:
SpaceX is preparing to build a terrestrial mobile network to "acquire quite a few" of the customers now subscribed to T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon. The message to compete head-to-head with the US carriers was delivered by SpaceX president Gwynne Shotwell and CEO Elon Musk during the Q&A section of the company's first earnings call.
"The spectrum that we purchased from EchoStar does have terrestrial components, so we definitely intend to build out the terrestrial component," said Shotwell. zh.title: SpaceX将与T-Mobile、AT&T和Verizon竞争
zh.summary: SpaceX宣布计划使用从EchoStar购买的频谱建立陆基移动网络,直接与T-Mobile、AT&T和Verizon竞争。首席执行官埃隆·马斯克和总裁格温妮·肖韦尔在SpaceX首次财报电话会议上透露了这一战略。此举标志着SpaceX意图在卫星互联网业务之外进一步扰动无线行业。
